عُجْرُوفٌ A certain small creeping thing, (Lth, S, K,) having long legs; (Lth, TA;) said to be the long-legged نَمْلَة [or ant]: (S:) or the نَمْل [or ant], (Az, TA,) or long نَمْل, (K,) the legs of which raise it from the ground: (Az, K, TA:) or it is larger than the نَمْل. (ISd, TA.) ―
-b2- And A light, or and agile, she-camel. (Ibn-'Abbád, K.) ―
-b3- And An old woman; as also with ة. (El-'Ozeyzee, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
